title: Personality
slide_intent: Introduce personality as a combination of traits so a writer can judge the overall tone of a piece without forcing every trait into each sentence.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can establish a distinct voice across programs through a shared set of qualities.
demonstration: Six trait names occupy an irregular stack of red bars. Notes at left explain that the qualities can be implicit and prompt the reader to assess tone.
practical_value: Review the emotional effect of a draft against the trait set, choosing the qualities most relevant to the story.

content_islands.name: Reader notes
content_islands.spec: Stack the explanatory, caution and exercise notes at left with their respective icons.

content_islands.name: Trait assembly
content_islands.spec: Set Inclusive, Joyful, Inspirational, Authentic, Determined and Courageous in large white letters on a connected, staggered field of red bars.
